That work gave us first-hand insight into one of the hardest realities of farming: very often, the person who produces the food has the least control over the value of what they produce. A farm’s profitability could depend on a good harvest, but also on a selling price the producer did not control. When both went well, it could be a good year. When yields fell or prices dropped, everything changed. And in farming, no year is guaranteed. In 2017 we decided to look for an alternative for our own produce. /en/store/1957/about/.sample: 1957 – About – El Mercado de Origen Secure and transparent shopping Secure and transparent shopping Orders prepared with care Tel: 603 02 95 09 Skip to navigation Skip to content El Mercado de Origen Home Shop Journal Producers Contact Products search Login / Register image/svg+xml 0 Shop Home / Shop / 1957 / About 1957 1957 3 results Products About Shipping The story of 1957 begins in that very year, when Gregorio started out in the world of olive growing. Since then, olive oil has passed from one generation to the next, becoming a way of life now shared by three generations of the same family. That connection with the olive grove is also the starting point for their oils. To produce their extra virgin olive oils , they work with olives picked directly from the tree at their optimum stage of ripeness, aiming to ensure that the fruit reaches the mill in the best possible condition. From there begins a process in which every detail is designed to preserve the olive's natural qualities.
